title: 連續壁槽溝穩定~Slurry-trench stability for diaphragm walls
focus: 穩定液壓差、槽壁滲透與連續壁接頭品質~Slurry pressure balance, trench permeability and diaphragm-wall joints
summary: 連續壁成槽時，穩定液必須與地下水、土層滲透性及地面載重共同維持槽壁穩定。本課從壓差與濾餅機理出發，連結槽段幾何、垂直度、沉渣與鋼筋籠浮力，再用混凝土量平衡與接頭水力坡降建立施工品質及鄰房變形的驗證鏈。~During diaphragm-wall excavation, support fluid interacts with groundwater, permeability and surface loading to maintain trench stability. The course connects pressure balance and filter cake to panel geometry, verticality, sediment and cage buoyancy, then uses concrete-volume balance and joint hydraulic gradients to verify construction quality and adjacent-asset movement.

units.title: 穩定液壓差的機理與驗證~Slurry pressure margin mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 穩定液的靜水壓對槽壁施加支承，地下水則從外側抵銷部分壓力，兩者須以同一高程及液面比較。液位突然下降可能使支承消失，密度增加雖可提高壓力，卻也影響沉渣、流動及混凝土置換，不能單獨追求較大數值。壓差不是完整槽壁安全係數，還須檢查土楔、地面載重及三維拱效應；高滲透地層可能無法形成有效壓力邊界。~Support-fluid pressure acts on trench walls while external groundwater offsets part of it, requiring comparison at a common elevation and fluid level. A sudden level drop can remove support. Higher density increases pressure but also affects sedimentation, flow and concrete displacement, so maximizing density alone is not a rational criterion. Pressure margin is not a complete trench-stability factor; soil wedges, surcharge and three-dimensional arching also matter, and permeable strata may not sustain the intended pressure boundary.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設液面相同、穩定液γs=11 kN/m³、水γw=9.81 kN/m³、深度z=20 m，Δp=(γs−γw)z=23.8 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: With equal fluid levels, γs=11 kN/m³, γw=9.81 kN/m³ and z=20 m, Δp=(γs−γw)z=23.8 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 分深度測密度並連續追蹤液位，對照外側水壓計；將液位差與密度差分開帶入壓力圖。每個槽段應保留液位與密度時間線；異常漏失的停留點由成槽及地工負責人共同確認。~Measure density by depth and continuously track fluid level against external piezometers, separating level and density differences in pressure diagrams. Retain fluid-level and density time histories for every panel; excavation and geotechnical leads jointly confirm hold points for abnormal fluid loss.
units.failure: 穩定液漏失會降低支承壓力，槽口沉陷或局部坍塌可能在平均密度仍合格時發生。壓差不是完整槽壁安全係數，還須檢查土楔、地面載重及三維拱效應；高滲透地層可能無法形成有效壓力邊界。~Fluid loss reduces support pressure; collar settlement or local collapse can occur even while average slurry density remains acceptable. Pressure margin is not a complete trench-stability factor; soil wedges, surcharge and three-dimensional arching also matter, and permeable strata may not sustain the intended pressure boundary.
units.misconception: 穩定液密度合格就不需要再監測液面高度。~Acceptable slurry density eliminates the need to monitor fluid level.
units.practice: 每個槽段應保留液位與密度時間線；異常漏失的停留點由成槽及地工負責人共同確認。壓差不是完整槽壁安全係數，還須檢查土楔、地面載重及三維拱效應；高滲透地層可能無法形成有效壓力邊界。~Retain fluid-level and density time histories for every panel; excavation and geotechnical leads jointly confirm hold points for abnormal fluid loss. Pressure margin is not a complete trench-stability factor; soil wedges, surcharge and three-dimensional arching also matter, and permeable strata may not sustain the intended pressure boundary.

units.title: 濾餅滲流的機理與驗證~Filter-cake seepage mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 穩定液在可滲透槽壁形成低滲透濾餅，才可把液壓有效傳給土骨架；若濾餅太薄、破損或無法形成，液體可能深入地層而失去支承效果。濾餅厚度也影響後續混凝土與土體接觸，成槽穩定與接面品質不能分開看。式中流速是達西通量而非孔隙內真實流速，假設均勻完整濾餅；開裂及粗孔隙穿透不能靠此一維模型表達。~A low-permeability filter cake allows slurry pressure to act effectively on the soil skeleton. Thin, damaged or absent cake permits fluid penetration and loss of support efficiency. Cake thickness also affects later concrete-ground contact, linking excavation stability with interface quality rather than treating them as unrelated controls. The velocity is Darcy flux rather than pore-water velocity and assumes intact uniform cake; cracking and penetration into coarse voids fall outside this one-dimensional model.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設濾餅k=1×10⁻⁹ m/s、水頭差Δh=10 m、厚度t=0.005 m，達西流速v=kΔh/t=2×10⁻⁶ m/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For cake permeability k=1×10⁻⁹ m/s, head difference Δh=10 m and thickness t=0.005 m, Darcy flux v=kΔh/t=2×10⁻⁶ m/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以濾失與泥皮試驗配合地層粒徑判斷濾餅形成，核對現場液位補充量及漏失位置。穩定液配方試驗需對應代表性地層；漏失機理未辨明前，地工設計者應審查替代支承或預處理方案。~Use fluid-loss and cake tests with soil grading to assess cake formation, checking field replenishment volumes and fluid-loss locations. Fluid qualification must represent the ground; before proceeding with unexplained losses, the geotechnical designer reviews alternative support or pretreatment options.
units.failure: 把試驗杯內泥皮表現直接套用於礫石層，可能漏掉大孔隙流失與槽壁局部失穩。式中流速是達西通量而非孔隙內真實流速，假設均勻完整濾餅；開裂及粗孔隙穿透不能靠此一維模型表達。~Transferring laboratory filter-cake behaviour directly to gravel may miss large-pore fluid loss and local wall instability. The velocity is Darcy flux rather than pore-water velocity and assumes intact uniform cake; cracking and penetration into coarse voids fall outside this one-dimensional model.
units.misconception: 穩定液黏度足夠就一定能在任何地層形成濾餅。~Adequate slurry viscosity guarantees a filter cake in every soil.
units.practice: 穩定液配方試驗需對應代表性地層；漏失機理未辨明前，地工設計者應審查替代支承或預處理方案。式中流速是達西通量而非孔隙內真實流速，假設均勻完整濾餅；開裂及粗孔隙穿透不能靠此一維模型表達。~Fluid qualification must represent the ground; before proceeding with unexplained losses, the geotechnical designer reviews alternative support or pretreatment options. The velocity is Darcy flux rather than pore-water velocity and assumes intact uniform cake; cracking and penetration into coarse voids fall outside this one-dimensional model.

units.anchor: 槽段三維效應~Panel three-dimensional effect
units.title: 槽段三維效應的機理與驗證~Panel three-dimensional effect mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 有限槽段的兩端土體可提供三維拱效應，因而槽長與深度會影響穩定，不能把無限長剖面的結果無條件套用。延長槽段可減少接頭數，卻增加開放面與施工時間，也可能穿越更多地層變異，方案取捨需要同時考量。長深比僅為幾何描述，並無通用允收界限；完整分析仍需土體強度、液壓、地面載重與槽端條件。~Soil at the ends of a finite panel provides three-dimensional arching, making stability sensitive to panel length and depth. An infinite-section result cannot be transferred unconditionally. Longer panels reduce joint count but enlarge exposure, prolong excavation and cross more ground variability, so these effects must be considered together. The length-depth ratio describes geometry and has no universal acceptance threshold; full analysis still needs soil strength, fluid pressure, surcharge and end conditions.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設槽段長L=6 m、深H=30 m，幾何比L/H=0.20。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For panel length L=6 m and depth H=30 m, the geometric ratio L/H=0.20. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 對各槽長方案建立相同地層及液壓邊界，核對端部與中段變形；把實際開放時間列入比較。槽段劃分應與地質剖面及設備能力一併核定；跨越異常地層時，由成槽設計者重審槽長而非照抄標準分段。~Compare panel-length options under the same ground and fluid-pressure boundaries, checking end and mid-panel movement and including actual exposure duration. Approve panel layout with geology and equipment capability; the excavation designer reassesses length across anomalous ground rather than repeating a standard panel arrangement.
units.failure: 長槽段若跨越局部軟弱層，端部拱效應可能不足，槽壁變形與超挖會先集中於中段。長深比僅為幾何描述，並無通用允收界限；完整分析仍需土體強度、液壓、地面載重與槽端條件。~A long panel crossing a weak lens may gain insufficient end restraint, concentrating deformation and overbreak near the middle. The length-depth ratio describes geometry and has no universal acceptance threshold; full analysis still needs soil strength, fluid pressure, surcharge and end conditions.
units.misconception: 槽段越長、接頭越少，就必定具有更好的整體安全性。~Longer panels with fewer joints necessarily improve overall safety.
units.practice: 槽段劃分應與地質剖面及設備能力一併核定；跨越異常地層時，由成槽設計者重審槽長而非照抄標準分段。長深比僅為幾何描述，並無通用允收界限；完整分析仍需土體強度、液壓、地面載重與槽端條件。~Approve panel layout with geology and equipment capability; the excavation designer reassesses length across anomalous ground rather than repeating a standard panel arrangement. The length-depth ratio describes geometry and has no universal acceptance threshold; full analysis still needs soil strength, fluid pressure, surcharge and end conditions.

units.title: 槽邊載重的機理與驗證~Trench-edge surcharge mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 吊車、履帶機及材料堆置增加槽邊土體的側向需求，作用不一定均勻，也會隨機具移動而改變。簡化側壓係數可說明均布附加載重的量級，但局部履帶及支腿作用需按距離與接地範圍分析，不能只用全場平均荷重。側壓係數須對應土體狀態及允許變形，局部載重還有三維擴散；本式不是吊車站位或支腿操作許可。~Cranes, tracked machinery and stockpiles increase lateral demand near the trench, with nonuniform effects that change as equipment moves. A pressure coefficient illustrates a uniform surcharge scale, but tracks and outriggers require analysis by distance and contact area rather than a site-wide average load. The coefficient must match soil state and permitted movement, while local loads spread in three dimensions; this equation does not authorize crane positioning or outrigger operations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設均布附加載重q=40 kPa、側壓係數K=0.5，增量Δσh=Kq=20 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For uniform surcharge q=40 kPa and lateral coefficient K=0.5, incremental pressure Δσh=Kq=20 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 核對機具位置、接地尺寸及堆料高度，將實際載重位置投影到槽壁分析，不以道路容許載重替代。成槽平面圖需標出載重控制區與機具移位條件；臨時工程設計者核准後才調整吊裝站位。~Check machine locations, contact dimensions and stockpile heights, projecting actual loads into trench analysis rather than substituting a road-load rating. The excavation plan identifies load-control zones and relocation conditions; the temporary-works designer approves changes before lifting positions move.
units.failure: 吊車靠近槽邊或支腿反力集中會提高局部側壓，造成地面裂縫與穩定液漏失的連鎖反應。側壓係數須對應土體狀態及允許變形，局部載重還有三維擴散；本式不是吊車站位或支腿操作許可。~A crane close to the edge or concentrated outrigger reaction can raise local lateral pressure, initiating ground cracking and subsequent slurry loss. The coefficient must match soil state and permitted movement, while local loads spread in three dimensions; this equation does not authorize crane positioning or outrigger operations.
units.misconception: 地面不沉陷就表示機具載重沒有影響槽壁穩定。~No visible surface settlement means machinery loading does not affect trench stability.
units.practice: 成槽平面圖需標出載重控制區與機具移位條件；臨時工程設計者核准後才調整吊裝站位。側壓係數須對應土體狀態及允許變形，局部載重還有三維擴散；本式不是吊車站位或支腿操作許可。~The excavation plan identifies load-control zones and relocation conditions; the temporary-works designer approves changes before lifting positions move. The coefficient must match soil state and permitted movement, while local loads spread in three dimensions; this equation does not authorize crane positioning or outrigger operations.

units.title: 垂直度偏差的機理與驗證~Verticality deviation mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 連續壁槽孔偏斜會影響壁厚、鋼筋籠淨距與相鄰槽段接合。深度越大，同樣角度或比例偏差形成的底部偏移越大，兩側槽段若朝相反方向偏離，接頭處的有效重疊可能比單段誤差更不利。此式為固定偏斜的線性估算，真實彎曲孔形須用全深量測；設計接頭能力需採兩槽相對位置，不能只看各自合格率。~Trench deviation affects wall thickness, cage clearance and neighbouring-panel connection. At greater depth, the same inclination produces a larger toe offset. Adjacent panels deviating in opposite directions can reduce effective joint overlap more severely than either panel's individual tolerance suggests. This linear estimate assumes constant inclination; a curved trench requires full-depth measurement, and joint performance depends on relative panel positions rather than individual compliance rates.
units.model: 原創教學假設：深度H=40 m、假設偏斜比i=0.005，底部偏移δ=Hi=0.20 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For depth H=40 m and assumed inclination ratio i=0.005, toe offset δ=Hi=0.20 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用槽壁超音波量測沿深度的輪廓，核對導牆基準與設備姿態，將相鄰槽段放在同一座標比較。吊放鋼筋籠前應取得全深輪廓驗收；超差位置由壁體設計者核定修正，不以強行下放解決。~Use ultrasonic trench profiling by depth, check guide-wall datum and equipment attitude, and compare adjacent panels in one coordinate frame. Obtain full-depth profile acceptance before cage installation; the wall designer approves correction of deviations rather than resolving them by forced placement.
units.failure: 偏斜可能使鋼筋籠卡住或接頭形成缺口，後續即使灌足混凝土仍無法恢復原設計連續性。此式為固定偏斜的線性估算，真實彎曲孔形須用全深量測；設計接頭能力需採兩槽相對位置，不能只看各自合格率。~Deviation can trap the cage or leave a joint gap; placing the specified concrete volume does not restore the intended continuity. This linear estimate assumes constant inclination; a curved trench requires full-depth measurement, and joint performance depends on relative panel positions rather than individual compliance rates.
units.misconception: 槽口位置正確就代表整個深槽都在設計位置。~A correctly located trench collar guarantees the full-depth panel position.
units.practice: 吊放鋼筋籠前應取得全深輪廓驗收；超差位置由壁體設計者核定修正，不以強行下放解決。此式為固定偏斜的線性估算，真實彎曲孔形須用全深量測；設計接頭能力需採兩槽相對位置，不能只看各自合格率。~Obtain full-depth profile acceptance before cage installation; the wall designer approves correction of deviations rather than resolving them by forced placement. This linear estimate assumes constant inclination; a curved trench requires full-depth measurement, and joint performance depends on relative panel positions rather than individual compliance rates.

units.title: 槽底沉渣的機理與驗證~Bottom sediment mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 成槽後的懸浮粒子會沉降在槽底，形成低強度、易壓縮的接面，也可能在混凝土置換時夾入壁體。沉渣厚度不是單靠穩定液密度可知，停置時間、粒徑及清底效果均有影響；壁樁承載與止水連續性需分別檢查。體積式只估算平均沉渣量，局部厚層可能更不利；沉渣允收需依端承、壁體品質及專案規範分別訂定。~Suspended particles settle after excavation, forming a weak compressible base or becoming trapped during concrete displacement. Slurry density alone does not establish sediment thickness; waiting time, grading and cleaning effectiveness also matter. Bearing performance of barrettes and hydraulic continuity require separate assessment of the resulting interface. The volume expression estimates mean sediment only; local thick pockets can be more adverse, and acceptance depends on bearing, wall quality and project specifications.
units.model: 原創教學假設：槽底長L=6 m、寬B=1 m、平均沉渣厚t=0.08 m，V=L B t=0.48 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For base length L=6 m, width B=1 m and mean sediment thickness t=0.08 m, V=L B t=0.48 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 在不同槽底位置量測沉渣，並核對清底與澆置間隔；用取樣及混凝土置換紀錄排查夾泥。清底驗收需記錄量測位置與時間；延誤超過核定條件時由監造要求複查，不能只沿用先前合格紀錄。~Measure sediment at multiple base positions and verify the cleaning-to-placement interval; use sampling and concrete-displacement records to investigate entrapped slurry. Record measurement positions and time at base acceptance; delays beyond approved conditions require reinspection rather than reliance on the earlier acceptance record.
units.failure: 厚沉渣會造成端部壓縮或局部夾泥，表面混凝土強度合格仍可能留下深部滲漏路徑。體積式只估算平均沉渣量，局部厚層可能更不利；沉渣允收需依端承、壁體品質及專案規範分別訂定。~Thick sediment can cause base compression or slurry inclusions; satisfactory surface concrete strength does not exclude a deep leakage path. The volume expression estimates mean sediment only; local thick pockets can be more adverse, and acceptance depends on bearing, wall quality and project specifications.
units.misconception: 清底完成一次後，多久再澆置都不會重新沉積。~Once the base is cleaned, no sediment can redeposit before concrete placement.
units.practice: 清底驗收需記錄量測位置與時間；延誤超過核定條件時由監造要求複查，不能只沿用先前合格紀錄。體積式只估算平均沉渣量，局部厚層可能更不利；沉渣允收需依端承、壁體品質及專案規範分別訂定。~Record measurement positions and time at base acceptance; delays beyond approved conditions require reinspection rather than reliance on the earlier acceptance record. The volume expression estimates mean sediment only; local thick pockets can be more adverse, and acceptance depends on bearing, wall quality and project specifications.

units.title: 鋼筋籠浮力的機理與驗證~Cage buoyancy mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 鋼筋籠浸入穩定液後，其有效吊重因排開液體而下降，但在混凝土置換時還可能受到黏滯拖曳與上舉作用。空心附件若封閉會增加排水體積，實際浮力不一定只等於鋼筋實體體積；定位系統須辨別重量、浮力與施工擾動。阿基米德式只給靜浮力，不包括混凝土流動拖曳與卡阻；排液體積需按實際封閉附件及開口狀態計算。~A cage immersed in slurry has reduced effective suspended weight, but concrete displacement can also create drag and upward force. Closed hollow attachments increase displaced volume, so buoyancy is not necessarily based on steel volume alone. Restraint design must distinguish weight, buoyancy and construction disturbances rather than treating every upward movement as one cause. Archimedes' expression gives static buoyancy only, excluding concrete-flow drag and snagging; displaced volume must reflect actual closed attachments and opening conditions.
units.model: 原創教學假設：穩定液γs=11 kN/m³、假設總排液體積V=3 m³，浮力B=γsV=33 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: With support-fluid unit weight γs=11 kN/m³ and total displaced volume V=3 m³, buoyancy B=γsV=33 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 核對籠體與附件體積，記錄吊重及籠頂高程，對照澆置速度與液面變化，分辨靜浮力和拖曳。澆置前由臨時工程負責人核定籠體定位與監測，任何上浮趨勢須依核定停留點處理並保存高程紀錄。~Check cage and attachment volumes and log suspended load and cage-top elevation against placement rate and fluid levels to distinguish static buoyancy from drag. The temporary-works lead approves cage restraint and monitoring before placement; any rising trend is managed under an approved hold point with retained elevation records.
units.failure: 鋼筋籠上浮會改變保護層及接頭鋼筋位置，固定不足可能在混凝土開始凝結後才被發現。阿基米德式只給靜浮力，不包括混凝土流動拖曳與卡阻；排液體積需按實際封閉附件及開口狀態計算。~Cage uplift changes cover and connection-bar positions, and inadequate restraint may only become apparent after concrete starts setting. Archimedes' expression gives static buoyancy only, excluding concrete-flow drag and snagging; displaced volume must reflect actual closed attachments and opening conditions.
units.misconception: 鋼筋比穩定液重，所以施工中完全不可能上浮。~Steel is denser than slurry, so the cage cannot rise during construction.
units.practice: 澆置前由臨時工程負責人核定籠體定位與監測，任何上浮趨勢須依核定停留點處理並保存高程紀錄。阿基米德式只給靜浮力，不包括混凝土流動拖曳與卡阻；排液體積需按實際封閉附件及開口狀態計算。~The temporary-works lead approves cage restraint and monitoring before placement; any rising trend is managed under an approved hold point with retained elevation records. Archimedes' expression gives static buoyancy only, excluding concrete-flow drag and snagging; displaced volume must reflect actual closed attachments and opening conditions.

units.anchor: 混凝土量平衡~Concrete volume balance
units.title: 混凝土量平衡的機理與驗證~Concrete volume balance mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 混凝土澆置量與理論槽體積的差異，可用於追蹤超挖、漏失或輪廓量測誤差，但過量不是品質良好的證明。澆置上升曲線若局部異常，可能反映槽壁坍落、夾泥或混凝土流入空隙，須與槽形及回收穩定液量共同判讀。此比值不區分超挖、損失及量測誤差，也沒有通用合格範圍；驗收還需材料、幾何與完整性等獨立證據。~Differences between placed concrete and theoretical trench volume help track overbreak, loss and profiling error, but excess volume does not prove quality. An anomalous rise curve can indicate wall collapse, slurry entrapment or concrete entering voids and must be interpreted with trench shape and recovered-fluid volume. The ratio does not distinguish overbreak, loss and measurement error and has no universal pass range; acceptance also requires independent material, geometry and integrity evidence.
units.model: 原創教學假設：理論體積Vt=180 m³、實際投入Va=210 m³，超量率(Va−Vt)/Vt=16.7%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For theoretical volume Vt=180 m³ and placed volume Va=210 m³, excess ratio (Va−Vt)/Vt=16.7%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 將每車方量、澆置時間與混凝土面標高形成曲線，對照超音波槽形及液體回收量，標出突變深度。量平衡異常須與地質及澆置事件一起審查；壁體設計者決定補充檢測範圍，不以單一超量率放行。~Plot batch volume, placement time and concrete elevation, compare with ultrasonic trench profile and recovered-fluid volume, and identify depths where the trend changes. Review abnormal balance together with geology and placement events; the wall designer defines supplementary investigation rather than releasing work from one excess ratio.
units.failure: 只看總方量足夠可能掩蓋局部夾泥，過量混凝土也可能代表槽壁坍塌而非有效增加壁厚。此比值不區分超挖、損失及量測誤差，也沒有通用合格範圍；驗收還需材料、幾何與完整性等獨立證據。~Adequate total volume can conceal local slurry inclusions; excess concrete may indicate wall collapse rather than useful additional wall thickness. The ratio does not distinguish overbreak, loss and measurement error and has no universal pass range; acceptance also requires independent material, geometry and integrity evidence.
units.misconception: 混凝土用量超過理論值就代表連續壁一定更強。~Concrete volume above theory necessarily produces a stronger diaphragm wall.
units.practice: 量平衡異常須與地質及澆置事件一起審查；壁體設計者決定補充檢測範圍，不以單一超量率放行。此比值不區分超挖、損失及量測誤差，也沒有通用合格範圍；驗收還需材料、幾何與完整性等獨立證據。~Review abnormal balance together with geology and placement events; the wall designer defines supplementary investigation rather than releasing work from one excess ratio. The ratio does not distinguish overbreak, loss and measurement error and has no universal pass range; acceptance also requires independent material, geometry and integrity evidence.

units.anchor: 接頭水力坡降~Joint hydraulic gradient
units.title: 接頭水力坡降的機理與驗證~Joint hydraulic gradient mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 相鄰連續壁槽段的接頭是幾何、混凝土品質及止水構件共同形成的薄弱界面。外內水頭差沿很短的缺口集中時，局部坡降會很高，可能引發滲流帶砂；因此完工水密不是只靠壁體本身的滲透係數來判斷。坡降不是流量，仍需滲透性及路徑面積才能估算出水；局部集中流與侵蝕可能使達西均質模型失效。~Panel joints are interfaces governed jointly by geometry, concrete quality and sealing components. A head difference concentrated across a short defect creates a high local gradient and may transport soil. Completed-wall sealing therefore cannot be established solely from the permeability of the concrete away from its joints. Gradient is not flow rate; permeability and path area are still required, and concentrated flow or erosion may invalidate a homogeneous Darcy model.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設水頭差Δh=10 m、有效滲流路長L=0.5 m，水力坡降i=Δh/L=20，無因次。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For head difference Δh=10 m and effective seepage length L=0.5 m, hydraulic gradient i=Δh/L=20, dimensionless. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 分槽段記錄水壓與出水混濁度，將接頭位置、實際偏斜及止水構件紀錄疊合，追查短路徑。接頭缺陷處理需由地工及結構設計者共同核准，監測應持續涵蓋外水頭與周邊沉陷，不能只記室內漏水量。~Record pressure and turbidity by panel, overlay joint positions, actual deviation and waterstop records, and investigate short seepage paths. Geotechnical and structural designers jointly approve joint repair; monitoring must retain external heads and adjacent settlement rather than indoor leakage alone.
units.failure: 接頭缺口可導致帶砂滲流與周邊沉陷；內表面止漏若未查明水路，可能只把流量轉移到鄰近界面。坡降不是流量，仍需滲透性及路徑面積才能估算出水；局部集中流與侵蝕可能使達西均質模型失效。~A joint defect can cause sediment-carrying leakage and adjacent settlement; surface sealing without tracing the water path may merely divert flow to a neighbouring interface. Gradient is not flow rate; permeability and path area are still required, and concentrated flow or erosion may invalidate a homogeneous Darcy model.
units.misconception: 連續壁混凝土本體抗滲合格，就代表每個接頭水密。~Impermeable wall concrete guarantees every panel joint is watertight.
units.practice: 接頭缺陷處理需由地工及結構設計者共同核准，監測應持續涵蓋外水頭與周邊沉陷，不能只記室內漏水量。坡降不是流量，仍需滲透性及路徑面積才能估算出水；局部集中流與侵蝕可能使達西均質模型失效。~Geotechnical and structural designers jointly approve joint repair; monitoring must retain external heads and adjacent settlement rather than indoor leakage alone. Gradient is not flow rate; permeability and path area are still required, and concentrated flow or erosion may invalidate a homogeneous Darcy model.

units.title: 鄰房角變形的機理與驗證~Adjacent-building distortion mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 深開挖壁體變形與地層流失可傳到鄰房，使基礎產生差異沉陷。結構反應與基礎型式、跨距及既有裂縫相關，不能用總沉陷一項代表損傷風險；角變形可作初步指標，但需扣除整體剛體傾斜並關注局部曲率。此兩點斜率不是通用損傷界限，也不能區分平移與彎曲；應增加測點、溫度修正及結構模型來辨識真實變形模式。~Wall movement and ground loss can transmit to neighbouring foundations as differential settlement. Structural response depends on foundation type, span and existing cracking, so total settlement alone does not describe damage potential. Angular distortion is an initial indicator, but rigid-body tilt must be separated and local curvature considered. This two-point slope is not a universal damage limit and cannot distinguish translation from bending; additional points, temperature corrections and structural modelling identify the real deformation mode.
units.model: 原創教學假設：兩測點差異沉陷Δs=4 mm、距離L=8 m=8000 mm，β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For differential settlement Δs=4 mm over L=8 m=8000 mm, β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 施工前建立建物裂縫與高程基準，將精密水準、傾度及壁體位移聯合比對，檢查測點是否隨建物整體轉動。警戒值應由建物評估者依資產能力訂定；監測異常由開挖及建物設計專業共同判讀，並保留原始讀值。~Establish preconstruction crack and elevation baselines, jointly compare precise levelling, tilt and wall movement, and determine whether points follow rigid-body building rotation. The building assessor sets triggers from asset capacity; excavation and building specialists interpret anomalies jointly while preserving the original measurements.
units.failure: 若只以平均沉陷管理，局部基礎差異可能先造成梁柱裂縫；基準點受影響也會掩蓋真實變形。此兩點斜率不是通用損傷界限，也不能區分平移與彎曲；應增加測點、溫度修正及結構模型來辨識真實變形模式。~Managing only mean settlement can miss differential foundation movement that cracks members first; an affected survey reference can also conceal actual deformation. This two-point slope is not a universal damage limit and cannot distinguish translation from bending; additional points, temperature corrections and structural modelling identify the real deformation mode.
units.misconception: 建物總沉陷很小就能保證任何接縫與構件都不受損。~Small total building settlement guarantees no damage to joints or members.
units.practice: 警戒值應由建物評估者依資產能力訂定；監測異常由開挖及建物設計專業共同判讀，並保留原始讀值。此兩點斜率不是通用損傷界限，也不能區分平移與彎曲；應增加測點、溫度修正及結構模型來辨識真實變形模式。~The building assessor sets triggers from asset capacity; excavation and building specialists interpret anomalies jointly while preserving the original measurements. This two-point slope is not a universal damage limit and cannot distinguish translation from bending; additional points, temperature corrections and structural modelling identify the real deformation mode.

example: 原創教學例：假設穩定液與地下水液面相同，單位重分別為11與9.81 kN/m³，在深度20 m的靜水壓差為Δp=(11−9.81)×20=23.8 kPa。保持液位與密度條件不變，若檢查深度增加10%至22 m，壓差增為26.18 kPa。這只增加液壓差，不代表整體槽壁安全也增加10%，因為土壓、地層變化及槽段幾何同步影響穩定。應把液位實測、濾餅形成及槽邊載重納入完整分析，再由成槽設計者確認可接受的施工條件。~Original teaching example: assume equal slurry and groundwater levels with unit weights of 11 and 9.81 kN/m³. At 20 m depth the static pressure margin is Δp=(11−9.81)×20=23.8 kPa. Holding levels and densities fixed while increasing depth by 10% to 22 m gives 26.18 kPa. This increases hydraulic margin only, not overall trench stability by 10%, because earth pressures, changing strata and panel geometry also influence the mechanism. Include observed fluid levels, filter-cake formation and edge surcharge in the complete analysis before the excavation designer confirms acceptable site-specific construction conditions.
history: 連續壁成槽時，穩定液必須與地下水、土層滲透性及地面載重共同維持槽壁穩定。本課從壓差與濾餅機理出發，連結槽段幾何、垂直度、沉渣與鋼筋籠浮力，再用混凝土量平衡與接頭水力坡降建立施工品質及鄰房變形的驗證鏈。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊；2020年：香港擋土牆設計指南提供二〇二〇年版本，其適用範圍不全面涵蓋深開挖。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。~During diaphragm-wall excavation, support fluid interacts with groundwater, permeability and surface loading to maintain trench stability. The course connects pressure balance and filter cake to panel geometry, verticality, sediment and cage buoyancy, then uses concrete-volume balance and joint hydraulic gradients to verify construction quality and adjacent-asset movement. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance; 2020: CEDD provides the 2020 retaining-wall guide, whose scope does not comprehensively cover deep excavation. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
